Product Features

  • Optimal size: The total dimensions are 80 x 34 x 180 cm. The high design of the cabinet does not take up much space and vertically expands the storage and display area, making it suitable for various living room designs.
  • Thoughtful layout: The interior is divided into several compartments. An additional drawer creates a 6-tier structure, thus meeting the requirements for sorting and storing various items.
  • Transparent presentation: The transparent glass cabinet doors allow for clear and easy display of collectibles, books or decorative items inside.
  • Reliable load-bearing capacity: The shelves are designed for a load of approx. 30 kg. Made of dimensionally stable MDF, they provide a secure hold for various items and do not deform even after long use.
  • Smart Lighting: Equipped with LED light strips that can be controlled via a mobile app, you can adjust the light color and brightness according to your needs, making it easy to create a warm, romantic or stylish living room atmosphere.
  • Convenient Drawer: This cabinet has a drawer for convenient storage of personal items or small items. The drawer is easy to open and close, allowing easy access.
  • Versatile design: The sleek, high-gloss white design combined with transparent glass elements gives the cabinet a modern flair and goes great with various interior styles such as modern, Scandinavian and minimalist.
  • Multifunctional use: The cabinet is suitable both as a storage unit in the living room for small objects and as a display cabinet for displaying personal collectibles and accessories, thus combining functionality and aesthetics.
